issues.description: Lecture constructor signature/order is inconsistent between the problem statement (UML/instructions) and the provided solution. The problem statement explicitly requires a constructor parameter order matching the UML: Lecture(String lectureName, int numberOfInscribedStudents, int numberOfGuestStudents, int numberOfLecturers, int numberOfTutors). The solution implementation defines the constructor with a different parameter order: Lecture(String lectureName, int numberOfLecturers, int numberOfTutors, int numberOfInscribedStudents, int numberOfGuestStudents). This mismatch will confuse students who are told to follow the UML order and may cause automated checks or example usage that expect the UML order to fail.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the constructor parameter order consistent with the UML and problem instructions. Either change the solution constructor to: public Lecture(String lectureName, int numberOfInscribedStudents, int numberOfGuestStudents, int numberOfLecturers, int numberOfTutors) and assign fields accordingly, or update the problem statement/UML to document the alternative order and ensure tests/examples match that order. Ensure all provided example usages and automated tests use the same constructor signature.
